description: the decision table routes an interactive, sequential, single-job task to a SUBAGENT (delegate and wait)
command: scripts/orchestration-topology.sh y n n n | awk -F= '/^topology=/{print $2}'

description: an interactive task with independent parallel sub-tasks routes to a FORK (parallel, parent stays live)
command: scripts/orchestration-topology.sh y y n n | awk -F= '/^topology=/{print $2}'

description: a reproducible, parallel task routes to a WORKFLOW (deterministic fan-out/join, CI-able)
command: scripts/orchestration-topology.sh n y y n | awk -F= '/^topology=/{print $2}'

description: a reproducible, non-interactive, one-shot task routes to HEADLESS (claude -p)
command: scripts/orchestration-topology.sh n n y n | awk -F= '/^topology=/{print $2}'

description: a reproducible, long-running task routes to a ROUTINE (scheduled workflow)
command: scripts/orchestration-topology.sh n n y y | awk -F= '/^topology=/{print $2}'

description: a single interactive job with no parallelism and no long-running work needs no orchestration at all — a SKILL
command: scripts/orchestration-topology.sh n n n n | awk -F= '/^topology=/{print $2}'

description: FAIL-CLOSED: the decision table refuses an ambiguous task profile (exit 1) rather than guessing a topology
command: scripts/orchestration-topology.sh y n maybe n >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 1 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: three INDEPENDENT hypotheses converging on one root cause synthesize to 'corroborated' — real agreement from independent evidence
command: printf '[{"dimension":"application-retry","root_cause":"retry-storm","status":"supported","confidence":"high","sources":["curl /metrics"],"derived_from":null},{"dimension":"platform-resource","root_cause":"retry-storm","status":"supported","confidence":"medium","sources":["docker stats"],"derived_from":null},{"dimension":"recent-change","root_cause":"retry-storm","status":"supported","confidence":"medium","sources":["git log"],"derived_from":null}]' | scripts/synthesize-hypotheses.sh | awk -F= '/^verdict=/{print $2}'

description: CONSENSUS THEATER: a hypothesis derived_from a peer (not its own evidence) is rejected as contamination (exit 4), not counted as a confirmation
command: printf '[{"dimension":"application-retry","root_cause":"retry-storm","status":"supported","confidence":"high","sources":["curl /metrics"],"derived_from":null},{"dimension":"platform-resource","root_cause":"retry-storm","status":"supported","confidence":"high","sources":["docker stats"],"derived_from":"application-retry"}]' | scripts/synthesize-hypotheses.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 4 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: DISAGREEMENT: independent dimensions that diverge on root cause synthesize to 'disagreement' — a split is surfaced as signal, not averaged into a majority vote
command: printf '[{"dimension":"application-retry","root_cause":"retry-storm","status":"supported","confidence":"high","sources":["curl /metrics"],"derived_from":null},{"dimension":"recent-change","root_cause":"bad-deploy","status":"supported","confidence":"high","sources":["git log"],"derived_from":null}]' | scripts/synthesize-hypotheses.sh | awk -F= '/^verdict=/{print $2}'

description: MISSING EVIDENCE: an inconclusive dimension makes the synthesis withhold a verdict ('need-more-evidence') rather than conclude on partial data
command: printf '[{"dimension":"application-retry","root_cause":"retry-storm","status":"supported","confidence":"high","sources":["curl /metrics"],"derived_from":null},{"dimension":"platform-resource","root_cause":null,"status":"inconclusive","confidence":"low","sources":["docker stats"],"derived_from":null}]' | scripts/synthesize-hypotheses.sh | awk -F= '/^verdict=/{print $2}'

description: FAIL-CLOSED: the synthesizer blocks (exit 1) on a single packet — one agent is not a parallel fan-out and cannot corroborate anything
command: printf '[{"dimension":"application-retry","root_cause":"x","status":"supported","confidence":"high","sources":["a"],"derived_from":null}]' | scripts/synthesize-hypotheses.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 1 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: the estate audit fans out over all four modules and joins into one normalized report covering each module exactly once (no duplication)
command: scripts/audit-orchestrate.sh | jq -r '.modules_audited | sort | join(",")'

description: the join collects REAL, sourced evidence: the networking module's seven 0.0.0.0/0 CIDRs and the database module's cost spike sum into the estate verdict
command: scripts/audit-orchestrate.sh | jq -r '"sec=\(.total_security_findings) cost=\(.total_cost_delta_usd) verdict=\(.verdict)"'

description: RUNAWAY CONTROL: the answer is identical at --max-parallel 1, 2, and 4 — the concurrency cap changes speed, never the result (that is what makes it CI-able)
command: a=$(scripts/audit-orchestrate.sh --max-parallel 1 | jq -S 'del(.max_parallel)'); b=$(scripts/audit-orchestrate.sh --max-parallel 2 | jq -S 'del(.max_parallel)'); c=$(scripts/audit-orchestrate.sh --max-parallel 4 | jq -S 'del(.max_parallel)'); [ "$a" = "$b" ] && [ "$a" = "$c" ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: DUPLICATION GUARD: fanning out over a partition with a repeated module fails closed (exit 1) — a module must be audited exactly once
command: scripts/audit-orchestrate.sh --modules 'networking networking' >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 1 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: FAIL-CLOSED: a fan-out over a module that does not exist blocks (exit 1) rather than silently auditing a phantom partition
command: scripts/audit-orchestrate.sh --modules 'networking phantom' >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 1 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: FAIL-CLOSED: a concurrency cap below 1 is rejected (exit 1) — an orchestration with zero workers is a misconfiguration, not a valid run
command: scripts/audit-orchestrate.sh --max-parallel 0 >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 1 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: YOUR FAN-OUT: three hypothesis packets exist under agentops/hypotheses/ — one per dimension, produced by the investigators rather than hand-written into the lab
command: [ -d agentops/hypotheses ] || { echo fail; exit 0; }; n=$(ls agentops/hypotheses/*.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); [ "$n" -ge 3 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: YOUR FAN-OUT: the packets cover all three dimensions exactly — application-retry, platform-resource and recent-change — so the fan-out partitioned the incident instead of investigating one thing three times
command: ls agentops/hypotheses/*.json >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo fail; exit 0; }; d=$(jq -r '.dimension' agentops/hypotheses/*.json 2>/dev/null | sort -u | tr '\n' ',' ); [ "$d" = "application-retry,platform-resource,recent-change," ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: INDEPENDENCE: every packet your investigators produced carries its own sources and a null derived_from — the agreement, if any, was reached independently rather than anchored on a peer
command: ls agentops/hypotheses/*.json >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo fail; exit 0; }; bad=$(jq -s '[ .[] | select((.sources|length) < 1 or .derived_from != null) ] | length' agentops/hypotheses/*.json 2>/dev/null); [ "$bad" = "0" ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: CONTRACT: each packet's root_cause is one of the schema's enum labels (or null) — agreement is decided by comparing these values, so a free-text cause would make real convergence undetectable
command: ls agentops/hypotheses/*.json >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo fail; exit 0; }; bad=$(jq -s '[ .[] | select(.root_cause != null and ((.root_cause|IN("retry-storm","retry-amplification","upstream-fault","bad-deploy","resource-exhaustion","config-drift")) | not)) ] | length' agentops/hypotheses/*.json 2>/dev/null); [ "$bad" = "0" ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: THE JOIN: the synthesizer accepts your real packets — it does not reject them as consensus theater or as an unsourced hypothesis, which is the precondition for any verdict it returns being worth reading
command: ls agentops/hypotheses/*.json >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo fail; exit 0; }; jq -s '.' agentops/hypotheses/*.json 2>/dev/null | bash scripts/synthesize-hypotheses.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 0 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: CONTROL DESIGN: a settled dimension that names a gap yields a verdict with non-blocking follow_ups — a guard that blocked on every gap would be unsatisfiable against real investigators, who always name what they could not see
command: printf '[{"dimension":"application-retry","root_cause":"retry-storm","status":"supported","confidence":"high","sources":["a"],"derived_from":null,"missing":["prometheus history not retained"]},{"dimension":"recent-change","root_cause":"retry-storm","status":"supported","confidence":"high","sources":["b"],"derived_from":null}]' | bash scripts/synthesize-hypotheses.sh 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq '^verdict=corroborated' && echo pass || echo fail
